rules.archaea: 15 reference or representative complete genomes, one per species, at least 3 phyla
rules.bacteria: 30, same eligibility, at least 10 phyla, Proteobacteria/Pseudomonadota cap 6
rules.eukaryotes: Homo sapiens, Drosophila melanogaster, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, plus 2 sampled
rules.mags: 5 GenBank GCA assemblies, Contig or Scaffold, excluded_from_refseq contains metagenome
rules.pilot: 1 archaeon, 1 eukaryote, 1 MAG, disjoint from measured
rules.phylum_order: shuffled with the measured seed, then round-robin
rules.tier_order: 1 reference/representative complete; 2 add chromosome; 3 any category, complete only
